title: Labyrinth graph health check: dangling edges clean, schema drift real, receipts clean

claims.text: Scanned all 296 parseable JSON files under artifacts/.lab/ for 'edges' arrays and resolved every 'target' against the set of existing node ids (filename stems plus in-file 'id' fields). Zero dangling edges found.

Scanned every 'claims' array for entries with status=='confirmed' and no 'receipt' field. Zero found -- the 'no receipt, no claim' rule has been followed consistently across the graph, not just in nodes written this session.
claims.receipt: python scan: confirmed claims with no receipt: 0

claims.text: 181 of 296 files (61%) carry no 'schema_version' field at all, against 115 (39%) at schema_version 3. The 181 are almost entirely a distinct, older layer -- literature-evidence nodes (evidence-bastos, evidence-wacongne, evidence-friston, evidence-keller, evidence-spratling, ~30 more evidence-* files on predictive-coding/oscillation hypotheses), claim-* nodes on the same topics, and context-checkpoint-seal / context-manuscript-draft-* / daemon_config.json. These look like a pre-Labyrinth or PRP-era literature-review layer, not decayed schema_version-3 nodes. NOT mass-migrated: per Conservation and the 'no deterministic migration receipt' rule, this is reported, not silently fixed.
claims.receipt: python scan: schema_versions: {3: 115, 'MISSING': 181}; sample prefixes: evidence-bastos(4), evidence-wacongne(3), evidence-friston(2), evidence-keller(2), evidence-spratling(2), plus single claim-*/context-*/daemon_config.json entries

issues: 181 nodes lack schema_version and their actual content/purpose (literature evidence for predictive-coding theory) was not read in this pass -- before any Prune or Compact action touches them, read a sample to confirm they are inert reference material and not still-live claims about this corpus.
